brief.claim: Adding nutrients to experimental ponds raises algal biomass: mean biomass in the fertilised ponds is higher than in the unfertilised ponds, at the two-sided 0.05 level.

data_keys.meaning: algal biomass per water sample, fertilised ponds
algal biomass per water sample, unfertilised ponds

brief.sizes: 4 ponds per treatment, 10 water samples per pond (80 values in total).
